text:
maya: quick flag  preview numbers flipped for a few tenants after the route-proto rollback test this morning. small per-session token bumps (10-90 tokens). noticed by CS.
liam: I think I saw that in logs. The retry path attaches `route_tag=retry_shadow` which seems to produce a different `route_resolution_id`.
sara: If route_resolution_id changes mid-session that will split the fingerprint and produce two partial ledger writes. preview join sees both until window closes.
jon: Confirmed. Joiner keys by `session_id` + `route_resolution_id`. Example lines: ```json
{"ts":"2026-03-22T09:02:11Z","session_id":"s-987","route_resolution_id":"r-42","route_tag":"primary"}
{"ts":"2026-03-22T09:02:11Z","session_id":"s-987","route_resolution_id":"r-43","route_tag":"retry_shadow"}
```
maya: Repro steps: induce transient 502 upstream -> proxy retries -> route-proto returns alt route hint -> ingest sees two rr ids.
ashley-billing: That will inflate preview (and in edge cases invoices) because the aggregation join window counts both. Billing flagged for review.
kate-devex: UX impact: preview per-route breakdown will show two tiny rows for the same session. Customers will ask. Need a console note.
liam: Short fixes: 1) stop emitting ephemeral retry tags from proxy (ops can flip) 2) ingest-side canonicalization: map subsequent rr ids to first-seen rr for that session for 5m TTL 3) joiner soft-merge: if second fragment < 5% tokens, ignore to avoid noise.
jon: We already have an alias table used for shard moves but it's async. Could add a cheap in-memory alias cache in ingest hot path. Risk: could hide intentional route switches.
sara: Could add guard: only alias if route_tag indicates retry or if timestamps are within 2s of each other. That narrows to transient retries.
liam: Implementation plan: ingest patch to rewrite `route_resolution_id` during pre-emit (cache key `session_id|tenant` -> first_rr, TTL 300s). unit tests + perf bench.
jon: I'll add joiner telemetry and guard: `metering.split_sessions.count` metric, and histogram `metering.split_tokens`. Also add alert if split_sessions.rate > threshold.
ashley-billing: Billing wants this triaged in 24h: if aggregated impact > $1000 or >0.2% customers, we'll run preview backfill and credits.
ops-bot: Incident logged MET-2026-149 "route-proto retry tag causing session split in metering" assigned to @liam @jon. Priority: P2.
maya: Who can patch proxy to stop the retry tag emission? If easy, flip now and we can pause canary.
liam: I'll open PR for ingest aliasing (ETA 3h). If ops can stop tag emission quickly, that would be fastest mitigation.
jon: I'll wire metrics and a quick alert. Also adding a joiner canary that consolidates fragments with identical session_id if within 2s.
kate-devex: I'll draft a short console banner explaining small preview variance during the investigation and add a CS FAQ snippet.
ashley-billing: Keep billing in loop; if we see invoices affected we'll prepare a credit playbook.
sara: I'll run a test harness to simulate transient retries and verify alias logic doesn't collapse legitimate model switches.
maya: Cool. Action items recap: ops: consider temporary flag to stop retry tags; liam: ingest alias cache PR; jon: joiner guard + telemetry + alert; kate: console note; sara: test harness; ashley: billing triage. Update thread when PRs linked. :thumbsup:
liam: PR linked: github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/894 — adding session alias cache.
jon: Metrics dashboard link: https://console/redwood/dashboards/metering-splits — added alert rule.
ops-bot: Deploy canary paused for route-proto across 10% of traffic.
maya: Thanks. We'll recheck previews in 6h and decide backfill.
